Sean Baker was so struck by Mikey Madison’s performance in Once Upon a Time in Hollywood that he revisited the film just to watch her scenes again. Then, after seeing Scream (2022), he walked out of the theater and immediately wanted her for Anora.

Anora blends romance, chaos, and class tension with the same raw realism he’s known for. Conversations feel lived-in, awkward, and real because the film leans heavily on natural performances rather than polished delivery. which is why the film went on to become one of the biggest Oscar winners of the season, earning Best Picture, Best Director, Best Original Screenplay, Best Editing, and Best Actress at the 2025 Academy Awards cementing its place as a modern classic and a landmark for indie filmmaking
